answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 8751 Country: India Title: I had seen a dream during ramadhan, between 2:30am-3:30 am. Myself along with my three children(1daughter 2 sons) are in a strange ground and are trying to leave the ground. Many Very scary dogs are not allowing us to leave the ground. Whenever we try to leave, they block our way from all sides. They are not barking, not attacking but are just trying to trap us in the ground. Please tell me the meaning of the dream. Question: asalamualaykum mufti sahab, I had seen a dream during ramadhan, between 2:30am-3:30 am. Myself along with my three children(1daughter 2 sons) are in a strange ground and are trying to leave the ground. Many Very scary dogs are not allowing us to leave the ground. Whenever we try to leave, they block our way from all sides. They are not barking, not attacking but are just trying to trap us in the ground. Please tell me the meaning of the dream. Answer ID: 8751 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2169/1696=H/1429) It is good dream, the dogs mean that though the temptations and satanic insinuations occur but they may not harm you in-sha-Allah, rather you shall be protected by Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
